cards.text: The Otis householdHans JohnsonInferredLive-in staffThe Otis household at 2033 Prairie AvenueFind this personWorkCoachmanBorn1870Age in 1904About 34Born inDenmarkTheir storyOn 1 June 1900 the census taker found Hans Johnson living in the rear building behind the house at 2033 Prairie Avenue, working as a coachman. Hans was born in Denmark in January 1870. Single at the time.How we knowInferred: worked out from cluesThe 1900 census lists them in this house on 1 June 1900, four years before this scene. The Blue Book, which places the family, never prints servants or young children, so the census is the nearest record that names them.The 1900 census, as written“Johnson, Hans” · HeadED 40, sheet 12B, line 83, leaf n817Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the rear building behind the house, as the head of his own household there (coachman); born January 1870, in Denmark, single.See the census page The census gives January 1870, age 30 on 1 June 1900. Written as "Coachman" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.SourceTwelfth Census of the United States, 1900: Schedule No. 1, Population
